Name: Altaria (Pokemon) (horse replacer)
Author: Zhuria
Description:
[size=3]This mod replaces the vanilla horse with Altaria from Pokémon. The sprites are from Pokémon Mystery Dungeon with edits and additions by me to make it work with Stardew Valley.[/size]

[size=3]Now updated for 1.6 and Content Patcher, and I added the new/missing animations.[/size]

[u][u][b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b][/u][/u][list]
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿﻿
[*]Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods
[*]Run the game using SMAPI
[/list]
[b]Preview:[/b]

[size=3][img]http://i.imgur.com/PgZ1ewy.gif[/img][/size]

Note: If you dismount from Altaria facing south, there's a short moment where it'll have two heads. Unfortunately I can't fix this without chopping off Altaria's head feathers in the front view.

Should you encounter any issues please feel free to comment or message me on Discord - my username is sepzero
